query:
SELECT 
  DATE(inspectionTime) as date,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN overallResult = 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ok_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN overallResult = 'NG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ng_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN overallResult = 'NTF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ntf_count
FROM product_inspections
GROUP BY DATE(inspectionTime)
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 10;
